method: Ran the locked showcase set (model09-v1 chat bindings) against model09/sft.onnx and model09/dpo.onnx, plus a next-word science completion set against model09/pretrain.onnx, with the exact production config (seed 7, temp 0.7, top-p 0.9, max 64 chat / 96 next-word, onnxruntime-web WASM, neox tokenizer). DPO was exported from the node's slot checkpoint (final update 412) after the daemon paused mid-shard.

sft.p1: 'esota Science History Chapter 4: The sky is a blue planet...' (katakana 'が' prefix token, off-topic)
sft.p2: 'esotaphotoAnswer Step 1: Analyze the answers to the questions...' (rama repetition)
sft.p3: '. . .pH of water? Answer in one word.' followed by Chinese-character garbage
sft.p4: 'esota to calculate the distance to the Sun...' 1.75 x 1.25 repetition to cap
sft.p5: 'esotaQuestion... direction of the electric field' formula ramble
sft.verdict: 5/5 collapse into a katakana 'が' prefix + repetition attractor; unusable in chat

dpo.p1: 'esota Science questions and answers. - The sky is blue because it is blue. It is a blue ball.' (repetition)
dpo.p2: 'esota Science/Gametology: The concept of photosynthesis...' chemical-reaction loop
dpo.p3: 'esota Science facts and concepts. - The chemical symbol for water is water. It is a fundamental concept...' repetition
dpo.p4: 'esota Today we are going to discuss the characteristics of the planets...' (mostly off-topic)
dpo.verdict: 5/5 same 'が' attractor; DPO does not rescue SFT

pretrain.p1: 'Water is made of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.' (correct, clean English)
pretrain.p2: 'Plants use sunlight to make food.' (correct, clean English)
pretrain.p3: 'The sun is the only source of energy.' (clean English)
pretrain.p4: 'A chemical element is a substance that is present in all living cells.' (clean English)
pretrain.p5: 'The Earth orbits around the Sun at an angle of approximately 0.8...' (clean English)
pretrain.verdict: 5/5 coherent English continuations that mirror the Science Explainer goal

reason: Both SFT and DPO collapse into the identical katakana 'が' repetition attractor (SciInstruct/English UltraFeedback permuted the model's register into a degenerate loop, the same failure mode as the Tamil models 5/6). Pretrain is the only stage that produces fluent, on-topic English continuations, so model09 presents pretrain in next-word mode exactly as models 5/6 do.
note: Supersedes the catalog's previous chat/PENDING/null stage and the authored chat bindings; model09-v1 is re-authored as a next-word completion set. DPO checkpoint was mid-shard (update 412 of the final shard) when tsliced paused; the exported dpo.onnx carries the partial-DPO policy, which echoed the SFT collapse, so no further training was warranted for presentation.
